WHAT YOU NEED TO COMPLETE THIS REPORT. • Information about all the jobs that you had in the last 5 years before you became unable to work. • ANSWER EVERY QUESTION FOR EACH JOB YOU DESCRIBE unless the report indicates otherwise.
